# Introduction

This document describes how to use AlphaSimR to model
genotype-by-environment interaction.

**This article is a draft of a planned interface, which AlphaSimR does
not provide yet.** The `legacyGxE`, `varGxL` and `varGxL_Y` arguments of
`addTraitAG`, the `useGxE` argument of `setVarE`, and the `year`, `locs`
and `returnPheno` arguments of `setPheno` do not exist, so the code below
is not run and would not work as written. Of the calls shown, only the
first `setPheno` call, which sets the environment with `p`, works now. GxE
traits are currently added with the `varGxE` and `varEnv` arguments of
`addTraitAG`, `addTraitADG`, `addTraitAEG` and `addTraitADEG`, as described
in `vignette("traits")`.

```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Legacy GxE trait
SP$addTraitAG(nQtlPerChr=100, mean=0, var=1, varGxE=1, legacyGxE=TRUE)

# New GxE trait
SP$addTraitAG(nQtlPerChr=100, mean=0, var=1, varGxL=1, varGxL_Y=1)

SP$setVarE(H2=0.5, useGxE=TRUE)

# Legacy GxE
p = runif(40)
year = 1
pop = setPheno(pop, p=p[year], reps=2, fixEff=year)

# New GxE trait
year = 1
pop = setPheno(pop, year=year, reps=1, locs=2)

PYT = setPheno(PYT, year=year, fixEff=paste0("PYT_", year))

pheno_df = setPheno(PYT, year=year, fixEff=paste0("PYT_", year), returnPheno=TRUE)
```
